items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The trial lasts 14 days and includes all Growth features. You do not need a credit card to start it.

items.q: Do I need to know code?
items.a: No. Everything is drag and drop. If you can write a document, you can build a page.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. Growth plans connect a domain you already own, with setup help in the dashboard.

items.q: Will my site look good on phones?
items.a: Yes. Every template is responsive. Use the mobile preview in the builder to check before you publish.

items.q: Can I sell things on my site?
items.a: Yes. Business plans add store blocks for products, prices and checkout links.

items.q: What happens to my site if I cancel?
items.a: Your site stays online until the end of the paid period, and you can export your content at any time.
Yes. The builder and your published site can both be fully bilingual, Arabic and English, including right to left layout.

items.q: Can I move my site later?
items.a: Yes. Export your pages and media whenever you like. Your content is yours.
